name: Jump Rope

instructions.description: Stand tall holding the rope handles with elbows close to your sides.
Swing the rope using your wrists and hop lightly off the floor as the rope passes under your feet.
Land softly on the balls of your feet with knees slightly bent.
Continue rhythmically for the planned interval, then stop and recover with easy breathing.

performanceMetrics.notes: Use short intervals if coordination or fitness is limited.

variationSuggestions.variationDescription: Perform one rope turn per jump to simplify timing.

commentsNotes: Use a surface with some shock absorption if possible.
